nodes.description: ERC20Basic public token contract being held by the lockup; target of external transfer calls.
Address that receives released tokens; set in constructor.
Timestamp after which full balance becomes unlocked; derived from block.timestamp in constructor.
Amount of tokens currently withdrawable; updated by div, sub and balance assignment in release.
Boolean guard ensuring the 50% partial unlock is only set once.
Constant duration of 365 days used to compute the release time.
Initializes token, beneficiary and releaseTime from block.timestamp.
Public release function; computes unlocked amount, validates _amount and performs external token transfer.
External view returning the token balance held by this contract.
block.timestamp (now) used for release timing logic and returned by currentTime.
External call token.safeTransfer(beneficiary, _amount) via SafeERC20; state is written before the transfer.
SafeMath sub on unlocked; arithmetic state update that can revert on underflow.
SafeMath div of the current balance by 2 used to compute the 50% partial unlock.
Caller-supplied amount requested for release; must be <= unlocked.
Local copy of token.balanceOf(address(this)) read at the start of release.

edges.reason: Constructor computes releaseTime = now + year, making the unlock schedule dependent on block.timestamp.
release branches on the condition now >= releaseTime to unlock the full balance, creating timestamp dependency.
currentTime directly returns block.timestamp (now), exposing the timestamp dependency to callers.
_amount parameter flows into release and is checked with require(_amount <= unlocked).
_amount is passed as the subtrahend to unlocked.sub(_amount), driving the arithmetic state update.
Local balance is divided by 2 via SafeMath div to compute the partial unlock amount.
release performs an external token transfer to beneficiary after updating state; the untrusted token contract can re-enter.
The token state variable is the contract on which safeTransfer is invoked.
The beneficiary state variable is the recipient of the safeTransfer call.
release invokes unlocked.sub(_amount) to decrement the unlocked balance.
The result of unlocked.sub(_amount) is written back into the unlocked state variable.
release reads unlocked to validate _amount and to decide when to reset it to the full balance.
release invokes balance.div(2) during the first-withdrawal branch.

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is only used inside release and is merged into the release function node.
The local balance variable is only used inside release and is merged into the release function node.
